description: This PHP file generates and displays execution timeline statistics for test plans in the TestLink testing management system. It includes functions for initializing GUI components, creating spreadsheets of statistics, and rendering reports, with significant logic related to report generation and data visualization.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP object used extensively for configuration and data structures.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class instance used to assign variables and display reports.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration object with subject line for report emailing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with test plan, project info, and configuration settings.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet file based on execution statistics and triggers download.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Prepares initial rows and styles for the spreadsheet report.

methods.name: initLblSpreadsheet
methods.description: Initializes label array used in the spreadsheet headers.

methods.name: initStyleSpreadsheet
methods.description: Defines spreadsheet styles for headers and rows.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Creates an array of cell range labels for columns in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for accessing test plan metrics.
